errors.STATE: This task no longer waits for a decision. Reload the page to see its latest status.
errors.REASON: Give a reason of at least 3 characters so the requester knows what to change
errors.QUESTION: Write a question of at least 3 characters
errors.CONFIRM: Tick the box first, because the decision cannot be changed later
errors.CHOICE: Choose whether to return it for changes or reject it
errors.CODE: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
errors.CODE_INVALID: The code is wrong or has expired. Open your authenticator app and enter the latest code.
errors.CODE_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes. Verification is paused; wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.NO_SECOND_FACTOR: Your account has no authenticator app yet. Set one up on the account security page first.
errors.STEP_UP: The code check has expired. Enter a code from the app again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not the person this task was sent to, so you cannot decide it
errors.SOD: You cannot decide this task because you are part of this document ({rule}). Ask your administrator to give the task to someone else.
errors.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: No approver was found for the next step. Ask your administrator to check who holds the positions in the DOA.
errors.LATER_VERSION: A DOA version approved earlier starts after this one, so this one cannot be approved. Contact your administrator.
errors.CHANNEL: Policy changes can be decided on the web or LIFF only
errors.NOT_FOUND: This task is no longer there. It may have moved or been cancelled. Reload the page.
errors.BUSY: Someone is working on this task right now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with different details. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and retry.
errors.INTERNAL: It could not be saved because of a system error (reference {requestId}). Try again, or tell your administrator this reference.
errors.FAILED: It could not be saved. Try again, or tell your administrator.
errors.SUBJECT: Information can be asked on request approvals only. A policy change is approved or rejected.
